titleBar.wait: Please wait until the installation is complete

welcome.updateTitle: A new version of KyberNow Link is available.
welcome.updateLead: You are going from version {from} to version {to}. Your computers, their passwords and your settings are kept.
welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Use your computer from this PC.
welcome.lead: Your computer's screen appears here, as if you were sitting in front of it. The picture arrives within a few milliseconds, and the keyboard, mouse and controller respond straight away.
welcome.note: Setup takes a minute and needs no administrator rights: it only affects your Windows account. Nothing changes on this PC until you click {action}.
welcome.desktopNote: KyberNow Link is in the Start menu either way.
welcome.willClose: KyberNow Link will be closed during installation.

close.title: Closing KyberNow Link
close.text: The open app closes while the installation runs.

files.title: The KyberNow Link {version} app
files.text: Its files go into your personal folder, without touching the rest of the PC.

webview.title: Display engine (WebView2)
webview.text: Downloaded from Microsoft and installed for you.

shortcuts.title: Start menu and pairing links
shortcuts.text: The pairing link from KyberNow Admin (kybernow://) opens KyberNow Link directly.
shortcuts.warn: not finished: open KyberNow Link once to complete it

register.title: Installed apps
register.text: KyberNow Link offers you its updates and uninstalls like any other app.

install.title: KyberNow Link is being installed on this PC.
install.lead: There is nothing for you to do. Each step appears below as it happens.

done.title: KyberNow Link is ready.
done.updateLead: Your computers and their settings are on the home screen, as before.
done.lead: Open it: a computer running KyberNow Station on the same network shows up on its own. Otherwise, add it with the pairing link from KyberNow Admin, or by its address.
done.where: You can also find it in the Start menu. Right-clicking its icon in the taskbar shows your computers.
done.whereDesktop: You can also find it in the Start menu and on the desktop. Right-clicking its icon in the taskbar shows your computers.
done.bar: Move the mouse to the top of the screen to show the session bar.

about.note: KyberNow is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence. The licence texts are in the project repository, on GitHub.

mock.arm64: KyberNow Link installs its version built for this processor (ARM64): it runs without emulation and decodes the picture with the chip.
mock.x64: KyberNow Link installs its version built for this processor (x64).
mock.gpu: {name}: it decodes the picture, which lowers latency and saves battery.
mock.display: 2560 × 1600 · 120 Hz: your computer can create a display at exactly this size during the session.
mock.network: 192.168.1.20: a computer on this network shows up in KyberNow Link on its own.
mock.webview: It displays the KyberNow Link windows (version 141.0.3537.71, from Microsoft).
mock.existing: It will be updated. Your computers, their passwords and your settings are kept.
mock.running: It will be closed during installation: a session in progress will be cut off.
